snippet.title: Restaurant Story Trailer
snippet.description:
The #1 FREE casual cooking and decorating game! Restaurant Story!
*Download on the App Store: http://bit.ly/RestaurantStory
*Download on Google Play: http://bit.ly/RestaurantStoryAndroid

Cooking delicious foods and designing amazing restaurants is the way to your Mama’s heart and is at the heart of this free, casual, cooking restaurant game!  

Cooking is life 🌞, cooking is love ❤️, cooking is good for the soul ☯️. In this FREE cooking restaurant game cooking is at the heart of this game with over hundreds of different recipes, cuisines and thousands of different foods to cook. 

▶️Design and choose stunning decorations and cook new dishes from your Mama’s favorite brunch foods to your Dada’s favorite desserts. This free restaurant game provides new recipes for your cooking pleasure every week! Dash to download this #1 FREE Android restaurant cooking game now! Enjoy the fever of owning a restaurant so successful your Mama will think your cooking is better than hers🙏! 

👩‍🍳Cooking food in a dash that your Mama would enjoy is what we want your free restaurant or diner or cafe of your dreams to be about! Don't forget to make sure your customers are happy and well-fed by choosing stunning decorations and tasty new dishes! New cooking recipes will be released EVERY WEEK so the game continually gets even better❗️

In addition to cooking you can design, decorate, and deck out the restaurant you always wanted. We thousands of different ways to design your free restaurant.  From hip corner cafe to pirate ships!
Why choose any other free casual cooking restaurant game that also allows you to design and decorate to your delight?!

🍕 Cooking in this free restaurant game happens on the stovetop or in the oven. 
-Design  and decorate something your Mama will be proud of, be it a coffee cafe, a 50s diner, an italian restaurant, or whatever you choose that provides stunning variety and creativity.
🥓Enjoy cooking top-class menus to suit your tastes.
Get your diner or restaurant or cafe ready in a dash and earn extra-special tips from friends.
- Simple and easy-to-use tap interface.
🌇Hundreds of dish selections from Creme Brulee to Fish and Chips.
- FREE cooking restaurant game updates with new dishes, decorations, themes and more EVERY WEEK!
- It's the #1 FREE restaurant cooking game!
